assets.prompt:
Editorial illustration for a regional city guide. Flat shapes with subtle paper grain, limited palette, soft daylight, calm composition with generous negative space in the upper third for overlaying a title. No people's faces in detail (if people appear they are small, distant, simplified, diverse). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, signage writing, logos, watermarks, flags, religious icons or political symbols. Avoid tourist-postcard clichés and do not combine many landmarks in one frame. 16:9, high resolution.
Interior of a classic cha chaan teng: green-and-cream mosaic floor tiles, booth seats, a round wall clock, steam from a cup of milk tea, afternoon light through blinds. Wall menu boards left completely blank.
Palette: charcoal #121417, tram green #0B6247/#7FE0B5, signal red #C62E2E, red-white-blue canvas stripes, warm off-white #F6F5F1. Central 60% contains the main subject; outer 20% edges expendable for cropping. Clock face blank with hands only, no numerals or ticks shaped like characters. Flat editorial paper-cut illustration, restrained grain. Output 1600x900 landscape.
Avoid: text, letters, characters, calligraphy, signage text, logo, watermark, flag, religious statue, shrine deity, protest, stereotype costume, geisha, samurai, rising sun, casino, neon cyberpunk fog, collage of landmarks, purple gradient, 3D render, glossy
Crop safety correction: no people. Put milk tea cup with steam on a small central table, fully contained within x=40%-60% and y=45%-75%; show the cup and saucer fully. Put the blank hand-only clock completely within x=60%-75% and y=25%-40%. Reduce foreground table close-up; wide interior view with decorative edges. Calm simple flat shapes, restrained grain, not detailed realism. Keep green-and-cream mosaic, booths, afternoon blinds light and blank menu boards.
